title: Delaware judge reassigns Elon Musk cases after accusation of bias
summary: Judge Kathaleen McCormick of Delaware reassigned cases involving Elon Musk after he accused her of bias over a LinkedIn post. The post discussed a potential $2 billion fraud case against Musk for allegedly defrauding Twitter investors. Despite Musk's accusations, the motion for recusal was denied, but the cases were reassigned to other judges.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the accusations of bias and the controversy surrounding the judge's handling of the cases, which could potentially impact the ongoing legal proceedings and public perception.
